strategy.name: Historical Winner Network
principles: Protect IT-only URLs with proven pre-collapse GSC equity.
Restore direct crawl and internal-authority paths from the homepage and six core category hubs to historical winners.
Do not restore retired off-topic alcohol, pawn, appliance or unrelated legacy content even when it had historical traffic.
Do not mass-expand or mass-noindex the current sitemap during this release; isolate the authority intervention first so post-release GSC movement is measurable.
